name: Umeå University
summary: Research university in Umeå, northern Sweden; four programmes taught in English: industrial design, life science, business and architecture.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: January round opens, 13:00 CET (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes: Life Science, Business, and Industrial Design (see its note)
January round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due
April round opens (EU/EEA): the round for May 2027 IB candidates; only Architecture so far
April round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
April round: final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
April round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Industrial Design
programmes.ib: IB grades do not rank you: work samples and a motivation letter (due 1 Feb 2027), then an interview in Umeå for 20–30 shortlisted. About 15 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science Programme in Life Science
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry at grade 4 (3 at HL), plus Maths AI SL at 4, AA SL at 3, or AA/AI HL at 3. No April 2027 round published yet.

programmes.name: International Business and Economics Programme
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AI SL at 4, AA SL at 3, or AA/AI HL at 3. Ranked on grades. No April 2027 round published yet (it had one in 2026).

programmes.name: Architecture Programme
programmes.ib: Maths as for Business, plus ESS SL or two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics. Up to a third of places by the Arkitektprovet test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: University Admissions says a student still finishing the IB must not apply in January; for 2027 only Architecture has an April round so far, so you cannot apply yet to Life Science or Business.
In 2026 International Business and Economics also ran an April round (UMU-P1214); none is published for 2027 yet.
Industrial Design is the exception: apply in January (work samples by 1 February 2027) and prove entry by 21 June 2027. May IB results come in early July, so ask UmU first.
